name: Kindred
source:
Not exactly  a comforting reality to wake up to after an accident renders your head busted wide open and your limbs broken in enough places to mimic a human jigsaw puzzle.  

In putting you back together, you're left with absolutely no memories. To make matter worse, you can't exactly seem to communicate that well - or speak for that matter - the accident made sure of that too.

Thankfully, you are greeted at your bedside by your saviors - the alarmingly attractive  and enigmatic duo, Dr. Marvelous and  Dr. Miracle. 

The pair are determined to help you in your road to recovery. But trapped  between 4 walls in a series of bizarre tests and increasingly odd haunted sightings,

Something isn't quite right.

[From [url=https://grey-journal-studios.itch.io/kindred]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在一次事故中，你的头被撞得大开，你的四肢多处骨折，以至于模仿人类拼图游戏，这并不是一个令人欣慰的现实。

当你们重新组合在一起时，你们就完全没有记忆了。更糟糕的是，你似乎无法很好地沟通——或者说这件事——事故也证实了这一点。

值得庆幸的是，你的救世主在你的床边迎接你 - 令人震惊的吸引力和神秘的二人组，奇妙博士和奇迹博士。

这对夫妇决心帮助你康复。但在一系列奇怪的测试和越来越奇怪的闹鬼目击中被困在4堵墙之间，

有些事情不太对劲。

[来自[url=https://grey-journal-studios.itch.io/kindred]itch.io[/url]]
